decision: Execute the selected current-Nanoda staged inference-cache regression as the sole ACTIVE item after committing its exact source lock, fixed two-test pair, claim limits and finite process budget. The staged cache witness already isolates an implementation-local validation-strength boundary, while the export route remains explicitly unresolved. Let/import clarification and Arena isolation remain independent shared-asset alternatives after this bounded test port.

A small current test-only Nanoda patch is locally feasible and potentially useful upstream; submission remains separately approval-gated. The negative-cache and reserved-namespace audits are less mature contribution candidates, and no maintainer response displaces this item.

The selected item directly reuses the exact historical cache witness and current portfolio source review. The semantics items retain their primary-source role, while HSBM remains the bounded discovery method once more concrete regression paths are reassessed.

All seven executable items have finite local entry paths. The current split-map contract and same-checker pointer lifetime remove the cache item's only source-level entry uncertainty; the other candidates remain feasible successors rather than blockers.
